disqualifier.note: Independent observations of one journal file: missing terminating newline versus an unterminated trailing JSON record. Combined-true is legal and both bits are copied independently into the rewrite.
Independent documentation-enforcement toggles. Combined-true is the default for functions; readers AND each bit with config.enforceExamples/enforceVersion rather than masking a single phase.

Sequential AND over different values (field-name tokens vs initializer text). Combined-true is the advisory hit; a numeric name with S.Finite/S.Int is the intended non-hit, so all four combos are meaningful.
Sequential filters on different inputs (parameter name vs initializer node). Combined-true is the defaults advisory; empty-object defaults and non-default-named objects remain independently legal.
shouldRunPgliteIntegration is constantly true; shouldUseTestcontainers selects the opt-in docker driver. Combined-true is the testcontainers lane and does not mask a third kind.
Independent hosted-vs-local and baseline-write toggles. usesShardedCoverageExecutor ignores both and returns true; combined-true is a legal hosted ratchet rewrite.

Two matching strategies over caller-supplied lists. Exact membership and prefix membership are independently true for different lists; callers OR them rather than treating the pair as exclusive kinds of one path.
Prefix helper versus a composite generated/vendor/ops exclusion predicate. Different inputs (prefix+path vs path); combined-true is the normal excluded generated path.
S.is guards for three different key schemas, not exclusive kinds of one string. A canonical alias key is not a package name; combined-true is unused rather than a masked union.
S.is of three distinct LiteralKits used to decode different CLI arguments (type vs app kind vs family). Not exclusive kinds of one value.

Missing-pattern probe plus a GenerationAction S.Union exemption. Combined-true is the exempted fallback; the if only reports missing-pattern-without-exemption, which is a permission overlay over free combinations.
